contexts: The StreamIt compiler supports the Cell architecture using the Multicore Streaming Layer (MSL) [5], which executes application kernels on the SPEs using static or dynamic load balancing.
The StreamIt compiler detects parallelism in the application and maps it onto an homogeneous MPSoC [20].
StreamIt expresses streaming applications using sequential pipeline, parallel split/join, and feed back loop primitives, which are also supported by Cell-Space.
Also, StreamIt does not support dynamic reconfiguration and event communication, whereas Cell-Space fully supports these advanced features.
Other run time systems exist that schedule data flow graphs and balance the load over available processors, and some, like StreamIt [5], even support the Cell processor.
